root_idea.summary: The root centers on gathering or being near: things collect into a portion or heap, and persons or objects draw close.
root_idea.development: From gathering comes the vocabulary of small collected portions, sand-heaps, and concentrated quantities; the same orientation extends to nearness, approach, and making something come within reach. Other derived uses describe pouring or scattering material into an aggregate.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested nominal is presented under the normalized singular citation form كَثِيب.

senses.definition: A mound or heap of accumulated sand.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression كَثِيبًا مَهِيلًا, the mountains are depicted as sand heaped up and loosened so that it pours down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect or bring something together; of a people, to gather or congregate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive use is described as collecting something together from a near place; the intransitive use is used of people gathering themselves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour something out or forth, including after collecting it together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use describes material gathered from a near place and then poured out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scatter dust, earth, grain, food, or the contents of a quiver, distributing it part over part.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The quiver expression refers to turning the quiver upside down and scattering what it contains; the lexical use is not restricted to quivers or to one material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter among a group of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use is connected with entering from a position of nearness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To charge upon someone, or to return against him after withdrawing; to draw near and attack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction with عَلَيْهِ describes a hostile approach or renewed charge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of milk, to become little or scant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported use allows the reduction to occur whether the milk was ordinarily plentiful or already sparse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become few or little, of a number or quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Form II lexical use concerning the smallness of a quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw near or approach; of game, to come within reach and enable the hunter to shoot it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The approach construction may take لَهُ, مِنْهُ, or إِلَيْهِ; with game, the result is that it becomes available for taking advantage of.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a small portion of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a كُثْبَة, a small collected quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become collected; of material poured into a place or of dust and earth, to collect there or become scattered in layers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Form VII use covers both collection into an aggregate and material distributed part over part.
It is used as an adverbial noun of place, including in expressions for shooting or throwing from a near spot within reach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small portion or quantity of grain, dates, food, dust, earth, milk, or water; a gulp, draught, one milking, or the amount held by a bowl or cup.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The quantity is described as small or as collected together; its plural is كُثَبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depressed tract of land between mountains.
Dust or earth; in an alternative report, a name for wine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical report preserves uncertainty between the dust-or-earth reading and the alternative interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Many or much; a large quantity or number.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is exemplified of livestock and herds, but the definition is quantitative rather than restricted to animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing collected together; a hill or heap, especially a mound of sand or another gathered substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The generic collected-material sense includes heaps or mounds used of substances other than the Quranic sand-mound context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small or common arrow lacking a head and feathers, used by boys in play.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also occur in a broader expression for shooting or throwing an arrow or other object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The withers or elevated forepart of a horse, extending from the root of the neck to the region between the shoulders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms include كَوَاثِبُ and أَكْثَابٌ.
